methods.name: Exact BRC Newton observer lattice and frozen-horizon observability
capabilities: construct canonical coordinate-projection observers on T56 residual coordinates
compute observer signatures, equivalence, joins, meets and rank/kernel dimensions
compare full-residual and edge-only safe quotients
apply exact rational Newton substitutions for a declared frozen schedule
compute scale-one edge signatures over a finite declared horizon
construct exact observability matrices and prefix rank/kernel profiles
typed_inputs: declared frozen Newton schedule of rational roots, positive multiplicities and RationalValuationScale factors
methods.hard_boundary: Coordinate observers do not classify arbitrary nonlinear observers. Frozen scheduled substitutions do not certify that perturbed states autonomously select the same roots, multiplicities or scales. Longer declared horizons can only refine or preserve the safe quotient.
